Hi Sofia — nice to meet you over email. I'm Monica on the procurement team. Below are the items we need to complete vendor setup and get a PO issued: 

1) Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (attached).
2) W-9 or local equivalent (we received your W-9 — thanks).
3) ACH/Banking details + remittance email (we prefer secure upload to vendor portal).
4) Insurance certificate if services will be delivered on-site (N/A for pure SaaS).
5) Signed MSA or redline acceptance.

Regarding payment terms: our default for newly onboarded vendors is Net 45 while we run the first couple of invoices and confirm invoice routing. We do have an early-pay option via our AP portal (managed by our payments partner) — typical discount is between 0.5% and 1.0% for payment within 15 days. If you'd like to request a steeper early-pay discount (e.g., 2%/10), we'll need business justification and finance sign-off.

Next steps for you: please complete the attached redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and upload the bank details to https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/fastvendor. Once we have those items, I'll submit for PO creation (expected lead time 3 business days).

Best,

Hi Sofia — Laura on Finance. Thanks for uploading the docs and completing the form. I've reviewed your request for 2%/10 on the first two invoices. A few points and options: 

- Standard approach: we issue PO PO-2026-0897 (procurement will confirm amount) and Net 45 for newly onboarded vendors while we complete accounting validation.
- Early-pay program: we can offer an automatic early-pay through our AP portal at up to 1.0% discount for payment within 15 days. This is pre-approved and does not require contractual redlines.
- Exceptional early-pay (2%/10): we'd need a business case and approval from our head of finance; that route typically requires accepting payment via our third-party financing partner (terms vary) and will take ~5 business days to get approvals. If you provide the first-invoice amounts and justification (e.g., ramp schedule, one-time cashflow constraint), we'll escalate.

Next steps: 
1) Monica — please confirm PO amount and issue PO-2026-0897.
2) Sofia — if you'd like us to pursue the 2%/10 exception, reply with the first two invoice amounts and a short justification; otherwise, indicate you prefer Net 45 + enrollment in the standard AP early-pay program.
3) Once PO issued, invoices should reference PO-2026-0897 and be submitted to ap_invoices@redwood.com.

Doc links: vendor portal (https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/fastvendor) and DocuSign enrollment for early-pay (https://docusign.redwood.com/fastvendor).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
